data.title: 克洛伊 · 游戏厅的连胜
data.description: 放学后游戏厅，她盘腿坐在格斗游戏机前打出连胜，围观的小学生越来越多；赢到最后的仰天大笑毫无形象，是真正的孩子气瞬间。
data.action: 放学后游戏厅，她盘腿坐在格斗游戏机前打出连胜，围观的小学生越来越多
data.promptProse: Chloe sits at an arcade cabinet with both hands poised over the buttons, orange eyes fixed on the bright game screen. Her red cardigan sleeves are pushed back from her wrists. A moment of victory opens into a broad delighted grin, while reflected colored lights trace her pale pink hair. A small group of fully clothed schoolchildren gathers behind the chair to watch her winning streak. Keep Chloe central, her hands and delighted face clear, while the cheering young spectators remain distinct in the softly focused arcade background.
